content: The Dcm shall not accept further requests (on same or lower priority) while <Module>_<DiagnosticService>() returns DCM_E_PENDING. Dcm- internal timeout handling (based on RCR-RP limitation) may lead to a cancellation of the external diagnostic service processing.
